resources.string: Hold a tag against the back of the phone.
This device has no NFC hardware.
Used only to unlock the chip. Kept in memory, never saved or logged.
If the chip supports Active Authentication, it signs a challenge derived from this address, showing the passport was presented for that key.
Hold the passport against the back of the phone, just below the camera bar, and keep it still for about 5 seconds. The chip is in the cover or the photo page.
The signature is checked against the certificate embedded in the passport. Checking that certificate against the issuing country\'s CSCA is a separate step.
No passport data stored on this phone.
%1$d passport export(s) stored in app storage.
